t: 圣殿骑士团第23任也是最后一位外公雅克·德·莫莱被活活活烧死.
te: Jacques de Molay, the 23rd and final Grand Master of the Knights Templar, is burned at the stake.
dz: 圣殿骑士团第23任也是最后一位外公雅克·德·莫莱被活活活烧死.
de: Jacques de Molay, the 23rd and final Grand Master of the Knights Templar, is burned at the stake.

t: 蒙古人于克米尔尼克战役中将克克洛克沃的波兰军队压倒并掠夺了该城.
te: Mongols overwhelm Polish armies in Kraków in the Battle of Chmielnik and plunder the city.
dz: 蒙古人第一次入侵波兰:蒙古人于克米尔尼克战役中将克克洛克沃的波兰军队压倒并掠夺了该城.
de: First Mongol invasion of Poland: Mongols overwhelm Polish armies in Kraków in the Battle of Chmielnik and plunder the city.

t: 弗雷德里克二世是神圣罗马皇帝,在第六次十字军东征中宣布自己为耶路撒冷国王.
te: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, declares himself King of Jerusalem in the Sixth Crusade.
dz: 弗雷德里克二世是神圣罗马皇帝,在第六次十字军东征中宣布自己为耶路撒冷国王.
de: Frederick II, Holy Roman Emperor, declares himself King of Jerusalem in the Sixth Crusade.

t: 黎凡特和阿拉伯半岛发生地震，造成多达 20,000 人死亡。
te: An earthquake in the Levant and the Arabian Peninsula leaves up to 20,000 dead.
dz: 黎凡特和阿拉伯半岛发生地震，造成多达 20,000 人死亡。
de: An earthquake in the Levant and the Arabian Peninsula leaves up to 20,000 dead.

t: 教宗佐西穆斯在教宗英诺森一世去世后当选.
te: Pope Zosimus is elected following the death of Pope Innocent I.
dz: 教宗佐西穆斯在教宗英诺森一世去世后当选.
de: Pope Zosimus is elected following the death of Pope Innocent I.

t: 罗马元老院废除了提比略的意志并宣布盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒·奥古斯都·日耳曼尼库斯为皇帝(英语:…
te: Roman Senate annuls Tiberius' will and proclaims Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (aka Caligula = Little Boots) …
dz: 罗马元老院废除了提比略的意志并宣布盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒·奥古斯都·日耳曼尼库斯为皇帝(英语:aka Caligula = Little Boots).
de: Roman Senate annuls Tiberius' will and proclaims Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus (aka Caligula = Little Boots) emperor.
